questions.q: How many subsets does a set with 4 elements have?
questions.e: A set with n elements has 2ⁿ subsets, so 2⁴ = 16. This count includes the empty set and the set itself.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT required for a relation to be an equivalence relation?
questions.e: An equivalence relation must be reflexive, symmetric and transitive. Antisymmetry is a property of partial orders and is in fact incompatible with symmetry except on the identity relation.

questions.q: The determinant of the matrix [[2, 3], [1, 4]] is
questions.e: For a 2×2 matrix [[a, b], [c, d]] the determinant is ad − bc = 2·4 − 3·1 = 5.

questions.q: The derivative of e²ˣ with respect to x is
questions.e: By the chain rule, d/dx e^(2x) = e^(2x) · d/dx(2x) = 2e²ˣ.

questions.q: The value of ∫₀¹ x² dx is
questions.e: ∫ x² dx = x³/3, so the definite integral from 0 to 1 is 1/3 − 0 = 1/3.

questions.q: The value of i²⁵, where i = √(−1), is
questions.e: The powers of i repeat with period 4. Since 25 = 4×6 + 1, i²⁵ = i¹ = i.

questions.q: The sum of the roots of the equation 2x² − 8x + 3 = 0 is
questions.e: For ax² + bx + c = 0 the sum of the roots is −b/a = 8/2 = 4. The product of the roots is c/a = 3/2.

questions.q: In how many ways can a team of 2 players be chosen from 6 players?
questions.e: The number of selections is ⁶C₂ = (6 × 5)/(2 × 1) = 15. Order does not matter in a team.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about propositional logic.
I. The implication p → q is false only when p is true and q is false.
II. The conjunction p ∧ q is true when at least one of p and q is true.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: I is correct: p → q is equivalent to ¬p ∨ q. II is wrong, because p ∧ q is true only when both p and q are true; 'at least one' describes p ∨ q.

questions.q: The sum of the degrees of all vertices of a simple graph having 7 edges is ______.
questions.e: By the handshaking lemma, the sum of all vertex degrees equals twice the number of edges, so 2 × 7 = 14.

questions.q: The volume of a cone of radius 3 cm and height 7 cm, taking π = 22/7, is
questions.e: Volume = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3) × (22/7) × 9 × 7 = 66 cm³. 198 cm³ would be the cylinder with the same radius and height.

The order and degree of the differential equation d²y/dx² + 3(dy/dx) + y = 0 are respectively
questions.e: The highest derivative is d²y/dx², so the order is 2. That derivative appears to the power 1, so the degree is 1.

questions.q: The sum of the series 1 + 2 + 3 + … + 10 is
questions.e: The sum of the first n natural numbers is n(n + 1)/2 = 10 × 11/2 = 55.

questions.q: The eigenvalues of the matrix [[2, 1], [1, 2]] are
questions.e: The characteristic equation is (2 − λ)² − 1 = 0, so λ − 2 = ±1, giving λ = 1 and 3. Check: their sum 4 equals the trace and their product 3 equals the determinant.

questions.q: The rank of the matrix [[1, 2, 3], [2, 4, 6], [1, 0, 1]] is
questions.e: Row 2 is twice row 1, so it adds nothing. Rows 1 and 3 are not multiples of each other, so exactly two rows are independent and the rank is 2. Its determinant is also 0.

questions.q: The inverse of the matrix A = [[2, 1], [5, 3]] is
questions.e: Here |A| = 6 − 5 = 1. The inverse is (1/|A|) × [[d, −b], [−c, a]] = [[3, −1], [−5, 2]]. Multiplying it by A gives the identity matrix.

questions.q: The value of lim (x→0) sin(5x) / (2x) is
questions.e: Write sin(5x)/(2x) = (5/2) · sin(5x)/(5x). Since sin(u)/u → 1 as u → 0, the limit is 5/2.

questions.q: The solution of dy/dx = 2xy with y(0) = 1 gives y(1) equal to
questions.e: Separating variables, dy/y = 2x dx, so ln y = x² + C. With y(0) = 1 we get C = 0, hence y = e^(x²) and y(1) = e.

questions.q: Match the functions in List I with their Laplace transforms in List II.
questions.e: The standard results are L{1} = 1/s, L{t} = 1/s², L{e²ᵗ} = 1/(s − 2) and L{sin t} = 1/(s² + 1).

questions.q: The partial differential equation ∂²u/∂x² + 4 ∂²u/∂x∂y + 4 ∂²u/∂y² = 0 is classified as
questions.e: For A·uₓₓ + B·uₓᵧ + C·uᵧᵧ the sign of B² − 4AC decides the type. Here B² − 4AC = 16 − 16 = 0, so the equation is parabolic.

questions.q: How many distinct arrangements of the letters of the word LEVEL are possible?
questions.e: There are 5 letters with L repeated twice and E repeated twice, so the count is 5!/(2! × 2!) = 120/4 = 30.

questions.q: A complete simple graph Kₙ has 28 edges. The value of n is
questions.e: Kₙ has n(n − 1)/2 edges. Setting n(n − 1) = 56 gives n = 8, since 8 × 7 = 56.

questions.q: The contrapositive of the implication p → q is
questions.e: The contrapositive of p → q is ¬q → ¬p and it is logically equivalent to the original. q → p is the converse and ¬p → ¬q is the inverse; neither is equivalent.

questions.q: The gradient of f(x, y) = x²y at the point (1, 2) is
questions.e: ∇f = (∂f/∂x) i + (∂f/∂y) j = 2xy i + x² j. At (1, 2) this gives 2·1·2 = 4 and 1² = 1, so ∇f = 4i + j.

questions.q:
Find the largest eigenvalue of the matrix
[[2, 0, 0], [0, 3, 4], [0, 4, 9]]
questions.e: The first row and column give eigenvalue 2. The block [[3, 4], [4, 9]] has trace 12 and determinant 11, so λ² − 12λ + 11 = 0 gives λ = 1 and 11. The eigenvalues are 2, 1 and 11.

questions.q: The solution of y″ − 3y′ + 2y = 0 with y(0) = 1 and y′(0) = 0 takes the value ______ at x = ln 2.
questions.e: The roots of m² − 3m + 2 = 0 are 1 and 2, so y = c₁eˣ + c₂e²ˣ. The conditions c₁ + c₂ = 1 and c₁ + 2c₂ = 0 give c₂ = −1, c₁ = 2. Then y(ln 2) = 2·2 − 4 = 0.

questions.q: How many 4-digit even numbers can be formed using the digits 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 without repeating any digit?
questions.e: The units digit must be 2 or 4, which gives 2 choices. The remaining three places are filled from the other 4 digits in 4 × 3 × 2 = 24 ways. Total = 2 × 24 = 48.

questions.q: The value of (1 + i√3)⁶ is
questions.e: Write 1 + i√3 = 2(cos 60° + i sin 60°). By De Moivre's theorem the sixth power is 2⁶(cos 360° + i sin 360°) = 64.

questions.q: The value of ∫₀^π x sin x dx is
questions.e: Integrate by parts: ∫ x sin x dx = −x cos x + sin x. Between 0 and π this is (−π·(−1) + 0) − 0 = π.
